description:
This file declares the module 'node:assert' providing type definitions for the Node.js assert module, including functions, classes, namespaces, and constants used for assertions in testing.
It re-exports the 'strict' namespace, and includes detailed method signatures for various assertion methods.

classes.name: AssertionError
classes.description: Represents an assertion failure error thrown by assertion methods in the assert module.

methods.name: function assert(value: unknown, message?: string | Error): asserts value; assert
methods.description: The main assertion object containing various assertion methods like ok, equal, deepEqual, etc.

methods.name: assert.fail
methods.description: Throws an AssertionError with the provided message or Error, indicating a failed assertion.

methods.name: assert.ok
methods.description: Tests if a value is truthy; throws an AssertionError if not.

methods.name: assert.equal
methods.description: Tests shallow, coercive equality using '==' between actual and expected.

methods.name: assert.deepEqual
methods.description: Tests for deep equality between actual and expected, similar to deepStrictEqual but with loose type checks.

methods.name: assert.notEqual
methods.description: Tests shallow inequality using '!=' between actual and expected.

methods.name: assert.strictEqual
methods.description: Tests strict equality using Object.is() between actual and expected.

methods.name: assert.notStrictEqual
methods.description: Tests strict inequality using Object.is() between actual and expected.

methods.name: assert.throws
methods.description: Expects the provided function to throw an error matching the specified pattern or object.

methods.name: assert.doesNotThrow
methods.description: Expects the provided function not to throw an error matching the specified pattern or object.

methods.name: assert.ifError
methods.description: Throws if the argument is truthy; used to test for error conditions.

methods.name: assert.rejects
methods.description: Tests that an async function or promise rejects with an error matching the specified pattern.

methods.name: assert.doesNotReject
methods.description: Tests that an async function or promise does not reject.

methods.name: assert.match
methods.description: Tests that a string matches a RegExp.

methods.name: assert.doesNotMatch
methods.description: Tests that a string does not match a RegExp.

methods.name: assert.partialDeepStrictEqual
methods.description: Tests for partial deep equality where only properties on expected are checked.

ctags.name: assert
ctags.pattern: /^    function assert(value: unknown, message?: string | Error): asserts value;$/
